evidence: Cross-sectional high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) samples were prepared by focused ion beam (FIB). The electron-beam irradiation experiments were performed using an HR-TEM (JEM3011, LaB6 cathode, JEOL Co. Ltd.) with an electron kinetic energy of 300 keV. The element depth profile of each sample was obtained using medium-energy ion scattering spectroscopy (MEIS). C–V measurements were performed at 1 MHz with a capacitance meter (HP 4284 LCR meter, Agilent Technologies) in the dark. The static water contact angle was measured with a contact angle analyzer (SEO, Phoenix 300).
